recognize_zh: 免疫組織化學染色中，成片細胞呈強而完整的細胞膜（棕色）陽性，核卵圓淡染、部分可見凹陷；配合 LCH 形態，這種瀰漫的膜陽性型態符合 CD1a 或 langerin 陽性的蘭格漢斯細胞。
features: Diffuse, strong brown membranous and cytoplasmic staining in sheets of lesional cells
Unstained oval to reniform nuclei (hematoxylin counterstain), some with indentations
Scattered negative cells, including small lymphocytes and larger pale histiocytes
Marker not labeled; the diffuse membranous pattern in a LCH lesion corresponds to CD1a (or langerin)
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (marker not specified) shows diffuse strong membranous and cytoplasmic positivity in sheets of lesional cells with oval to reniform, focally indented nuclei. Scattered small lymphocytes and occasional larger histiocytes are negative. In the context of Langerhans cell histiocytosis, this pattern is typical of CD1a or langerin (CD207) expression, although the antibody cannot be confirmed from the image. Findings support the diagnosis of Langerhans cell histiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are S100-positive but CD1a- and langerin-negative.
Indeterminate cells are CD1a- and S100-positive but langerin-negative and lack Birbeck granules.
These histiocytes express CD68/CD163 and factor XIIIa and are CD1a-negative.
T-LBL can be CD1a-positive but is TdT- and CD3-positive with blastic chromatin rather than grooved histiocytoid nuclei.
